title: Na maar tamache
body:
Na maar tamache masoom badi hai..(4)
Na Mar tamachay Masoom badi hai
Shabbir ne naize pe ek aah bhari hai
Jo baba ke seene ke siwa so bhi na pai..(2)
Wo khak ke bistar pe chup chap padi hai
Na shimr chala pae gale paak pe khanjar..(2)
Masoom se haton se wo rok rahi hai
Zalim se mere baba ko tum aake bachalo.(2)
abbas ko maqtal me wo dhundh rahi hai
Mar jaegi tanhai me e teri sakina..(2)
zindaan me ae bhai veerani badi hai
Mazloomi sakina ki zara aake to dekho..(2)
poti dare zinda pe khud maut khadi hai
Jo garmi me sehra o ki murjha gai shayad..(2)
zahra tere gulshan ki masoom kali hai
Na Mar tamachay Masoom badi hai - 2
